plan.summary: When a Stripe invoice is finalized, create a corresponding invoice in QuickBooks and add a line item for each Stripe invoice line, then attach the Stripe invoice URL to the QuickBooks invoice.

fieldMapping.note: Stripe invoice ID used as QuickBooks DocNumber
Map each Stripe line description to QuickBooks line item description
Map each Stripe line amount (in cents) to QuickBooks amount
Convert Stripe currency code to QuickBooks currency enum
Attach Stripe invoice URL as a custom field or attachment on the QuickBooks invoice

assumptions: The Stripe webhook is already configured and delivering invoice.finalized events.
The QuickBooks company file exists and the integration has OAuth access with write permissions.
Each Stripe invoice line can be directly mapped to a QuickBooks line item without additional transformation.
QuickBooks supports attaching a URL as a custom field or document reference; if not, the URL will be logged for manual review.

data.description: My First Invoice Item (created for API docs)

notes: Stripe invoice.finalized webhook delivers the full invoice object including lines.data array with amount in cents, currency, description, and hosted invoice URL.
Lines are paginated via the /v1/invoices/:id/lines endpoint with has_more and url for pagination; connector must follow pagination if has_more is true.
No auth needed in spec as webhook delivery is handled by platform; Stripe signature verification is assumed elsewhere.

Line.Description: My First Invoice Item (created for API docs)

notes: QuickBooks Online API requires realmID and OAuth 2.0 Bearer token.
Amount must be in decimal dollars (convert from cents).
Line items require DetailType and SalesItemLineDetail with ItemRef; assuming a default service item.
CustomField used to store Stripe invoice URL; assumes a custom field named 'Stripe Invoice URL' with DefinitionId '1'.
No pagination in create invoice endpoint.
QuickBooks Attach endpoint used to attach document (here, Stripe URL as text file) to invoice via AttachableRef.EntityRef.
Requires Invoice ID from previous create invoice response.
File contains base64-encoded Stripe invoice URL.
ContentType 'text/plain' used for URL; could also be 'text/uri-list'.
